title: Decision questions: an Other answer, a note on any choice, and the same questions in chat
summary: Choose where Other and Add a note appear, when to send a partly answered chat message, and how Praxis should treat a typed reply. I recommend showing Other last on every question, putting Add a note beneath the selected answer, letting you send any finished answers together, and keeping typed replies in the conversation. To give a different direction in this review, pick Other and name the question in a review comment.

screens.title: Document panel · Before answering
screens.notes: D8 and D9 are a two-question excerpt from the 19 Gay I Club decisions. The counts refer to this excerpt. Tapping the built-in Other row opens Your answer. An empty or whitespace-only entry keeps Save answer disabled and the question open. All filled answers in these screens are examples.

screens.title: Document panel · Answers saved to review
screens.notes: Robert's write-in occupies the selected answer row. On D9 the chosen action stays visible under Later. Add a note opens a small optional field directly beneath any selected answer. Save note keeps the choice intact. Both answers stay in the draft until Finish review sends them.

screens.title: Document panel · Before answering
screens.notes: Full scroll view at phone width. Your answer opens directly below Other and takes focus. The next question follows in reading order.

screens.title: Document panel · Answers saved to review
screens.notes: The checkmark identifies the answer. The indented Your note has its own label and speech icon. You can edit a note independently. Choosing a different answer starts a fresh note for that choice.

screens.title: Chat message · Before answering
screens.notes: The same choices, recommendations and notes live inside the Praxis message. Answer opens the third question in place. The composer stays available for conversation.

screens.title: Chat message · Two sent, one open
screens.notes: Send 2 answers delivers just D8 and D9. The message shows both submitted answers verbatim. D10 stays open in the original message. Answering it later sends only D10. A selection in progress stays a draft until sent.

screens.title: Chat message · Before answering
screens.notes: Full scroll view at phone width. A plain-text reply appears as a normal chat message. Praxis can discuss it or point back to an open question. The answer count and stored selections change only through the decision controls.

screens.title: Chat message · Two sent, one open
screens.notes: The agent receives Robert’s submitted answers with decision_id, definition_hash, answered_at, verified answered_by and authority. The review supplies document_id, revision_id and content_hash. Chat supplies conversation_id, message_id, an immutable message version and its hash. Recheck version and definition at send. If either changed, keep the draft and ask again. D8 carries {"kind": "other", "answer": "other", "text": "Show a demo slot only when someone volunteers."}. Its text is Robert’s own direction. D9 carries {"kind": "option", "answer": "later", "note": "Start with screenshots when uploads are ready."}. Resolve the listed action by ID. The optional note on either kind travels verbatim as Robert’s context.
